t: Look at the stainless steel sculpture in front of you. This is Paternoster Vents, also known as Angel's Wings, made in 2002 by Thomas Heatherwick. It stands on Paternoster Lane, on the west side of the Paternoster Square development, close to the junction with Warwick Lane and Ave Maria Lane and Amen Corner. It looks like a piece of art, but it has a practical job: it provides ventilation for an underground electrical substation. Heatherwick is an English designer who founded Heatherwick Studio, so this is a small work by a designer who now works at much larger scale.
